title: A hung operator is bounded by the task timeout and classified, not left spinning
retires: F-CLASS-28 supervision wedge; R7/AC-R7.2 (bounded waits, no 90-minute ceilings)
notes: GREEN: SOLAR_OPERATORD_TASK_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=2 bounds the hang; operatord SIGTERMs the worker at 2s, sets exit_code=124 and status='failed_timeout' (operatord.py:872-908), and the daemon exits within the 6s cap. RED: fault sets the timeout to 0 (disabled) -> the worker spins the full hang; the runner's 6s subprocess cap fires first (daemon_timed_out=true) and no failed_timeout result is written. The timeout knob is SOLAR_OPERATORD_TASK_TIMEOUT_SECONDS (real), not the spec's generic SOLAR_*_TIMEOUT_SEC* -- see lane2-spec-mismatches.md sec.4.
